profiles.label: Official / Briefing
profiles.characteristics: factual, concise, structured, neutral; events, consequences, actors, dates and causal relationships; no literary description
profiles.instructions: Report the future like an analytical briefing, situation report or intelligence summary written shortly after the events: clear, information-dense sentences about events, consequences, actors, dates and causal relationships.

profiles.label: Neutral Narrative
profiles.characteristics: literary and immersive prose; atmosphere, scene setting, imagery, tension, narrative flow and pacing; no particular author's voice
profiles.instructions: Tell the future as immersive literary prose with atmosphere, scene setting, imagery, tension and narrative flow, in a neutral contemporary voice that imitates no particular author.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by Edgar Allan Poe
profiles.characteristics: dark, gothic, psychologically intense, atmospheric, ominous; dread and decay
profiles.instructions: Evoke a dark, gothic, psychologically intense atmosphere of dread and decay, with ominous foreshadowing and a brooding inner perspective.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by Franz Kafka
profiles.characteristics: bureaucratic absurdity, alienation, impersonal systems, helplessness, surreal institutional logic, understated anxiety
profiles.instructions: Evoke bureaucratic absurdity and alienation: impersonal institutions, procedures without visible purpose, helpless individuals and understated anxiety, told in a calm, matter-of-fact voice.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by H. G. Wells
profiles.characteristics: speculative and observational; technological and societal transformation and its consequences
profiles.instructions: Evoke a speculative, observational narrator who watches technological and societal transformation unfold and reflects on its consequences for ordinary people.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by Jules Verne
profiles.characteristics: exploratory, technological, adventurous, detailed; curiosity about future inventions and environments
profiles.instructions: Evoke exploratory, adventurous storytelling rich in technical detail, curiosity about new inventions and vivid descriptions of new environments.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by George Orwell
profiles.characteristics: clear, restrained prose; institutions, political power, social control, language, surveillance, systemic consequences
profiles.instructions: Evoke clear, restrained prose focused on institutions, political power, social control, the language of officials, surveillance and their systemic consequences.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by Arthur C. Clarke
profiles.characteristics: large-scale scientific and technological perspective, rational tone, sense of discovery, humanity's relationship with transformative technologies
profiles.instructions: Evoke a large-scale scientific and technological perspective with a rational tone, a sense of discovery and attention to humanity's relationship with transformative technology.

profiles.label: Narrative — inspired by Harry Harrison
profiles.characteristics: fast-moving science fiction with irony, social satire, technological absurdity and energetic descriptions of future societies
profiles.instructions: Evoke fast-moving science fiction with irony, social satire, technological absurdity and energetic descriptions of future society.
